```{r}
# 1. Cargar librerías necesarias
library(tidyverse)
#install.packages("psych")
library(psych)

# 2. Cargar el dataset crudo
df_raw <- read_csv("data_exp_287108-v3_tasks.csv")

# 3. Filtrar únicamente los ensayos de interés (trial y trial2)
# Esto descarta descansos, pantallas de inicio, pausas y pantallas finales
df_trials <- df_raw %>%
  filter(Display %in% c("trial", "trial2"))

# Verificación de conteo por ensayo tras el filtrado
table(df_trials$Display, useNA = "ifany")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TABLAS DESCRIPTIVAS SIN LIMPIEZA 
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 4. Tabla descriptiva con psych (N, Media, SD, Mediana, IQR, Min, Max, Skew, Kurtosis)
descriptivos_rt <- describeBy(df_trials$`Reaction Time`, 
                              group = df_trials$Display, 
                              mat = TRUE, 
                              digits = 2)
print(descriptivos_rt)

# 5. Tabla resumen personalizada con dplyr
tabla_resumen <- df_trials %>%
  group_by(Display) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Total = n(),
    Perdidos_RT = sum(is.na(`Reaction Time`)),
    Media_RT = mean(`Reaction Time`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mediana_RT = median(`Reaction Time`, na.rm = TRUE),
    DT_RT = sd(`Reaction Time`, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_RT = IQR(`Reaction Time`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_RT = min(`Reaction Time`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_RT = max(`Reaction Time`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tasa_Aciertos_Pct = mean(Correct, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )
print(tabla_resumen)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GRÁFICOS EXPLORATORIOS
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A) Histogramas separados por facetas (Trial vs Trial2)
ggplot(df_trials %>% filter(!is.na(`Reaction Time`)), 
       aes(x = `Reaction Time`, fill = Display)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, color = "black", alpha = 0.7) + 
  facet_wrap(~ Display, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(200, 2000)) + 
  labs(title = "Distribución de Reaction Time por Ensayo (Zoom 200 - 2000 ms)",
       x = "Reaction Time (ms)", 
       y = "Frecuencia") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# B) Curva de densidad comparativa superpuesta
ggplot(df_trials %>% filter(!is.na(`Reaction Time`)), 
       aes(x = `Reaction Time`, color = Display, fill = Display)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 2000)) +
  labs(title = "Curva de densidad comparativa de Tiempos de Reacción (0 - 2000 ms)",
       x = "Reaction Time (ms)", 
       y = "Densidad",
       color = "Condición",
       fill = "Condición") +
  theme_minimal()

# C) Diagrama de caja (Boxplot) para inspeccionar asimetría y dispersión
ggplot(df_trials %>% filter(!is.na(`Reaction Time`)), 
       aes(x = Display, y = `Reaction Time`, fill = Display)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.colour = "red", outlier.shape = 16) +
  labs(title = "Boxplot de Reaction Time (Trial vs Trial2)",
       x = "Ensayo", 
       y = "Reaction Time (ms)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# D) Proporción de Precisión (Aciertos vs. Errores)
ggplot(df_trials %>% filter(!is.na(Correct)), 
       aes(x = Display, fill = factor(Correct))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "#D95F02", "1" = "#1B9E77"), 
                    labels = c("Error (0)", "Acierto (1)")) +
  labs(title = "Proporción de Aciertos y Errores por Ensayo",
       x = "Ensayo", 
       y = "Porcentaje", 
       fill = "Precisión") +
  theme_minimal()
```
